findings.description: No template rendering or dynamic include exists in the file, so there is no sink that would interpret an injected SSI directive. The sole remote-content path (_image_url_to_base64) enforces https-only plus a fail-closed host allow-list, rejects hosts resolving to private/loopback/link-local/reserved/multicast/unspecified addresses, disables redirects with an explicit refusal, requires a SHA-256 digest match and optional RSA-PSS signature, and requires Pillow to parse the bytes as one of four allow-listed formats within a pixel ceiling. Remote bytes are stored as a validated image, never evaluated as page content.
